result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the Company may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, owes no exit penalty, and HDI may only elect non-renewal at term-end on 90 days' notice. However, the added right to terminate “in whole or in part” is not required by the playbook and may create an unintended partial-termination right. In addition, stating that the Company's “sole payment obligation” is for pre-termination Section 3 fees could extinguish other accrued or surviving payment obligations unrelated to the termination fee. Those points make the revision broader than necessary despite otherwise serviceable drafting.
